title: Branch durable planning mode for local model runners
objective: Explore a separate implementation path for durable planning mode that emphasizes local vLLM and Ollama runner routing without changing the original plan.
prompt: Branch the existing durable planning-mode plan and produce a separate goal candidate for local model runner integration.
author: operator
summary: Branch from the original planning-mode plan for a local-model-heavy route.

authoring.intake_summary: This branch preserves the original plan history and investigates local model routing as a competing implementation path.
acceptance_evidence: compiled goal receives a new goal_id
original plan and compiled goal history are not overwritten
constraints: do not mutate the source plan
use stable subgoal IDs for branch-specific tasks
require human review before submitting the compiled goal
assumptions: the source plan remains available in the goal store
open_questions: Which local model runner should be the first candidate?

plan.summary: Create a branch plan that routes local model runner work through the same durable task tree.

subgoals.title: Local runner contract
subgoals.objective: Define runner capabilities and model-route constraints for vLLM and Ollama candidates.

subgoals.title: Branch review
subgoals.objective: Compare this branch against the source plan before compilation.

distribution_notes: Keep this branch separate from the source plan until the operator selects it.

questions.question: Which local model runner should be the first candidate?

decisions.title: Keep source plan immutable
decisions.decision: This branch uses a new plan_id and records the original plan as source_plan_id.
decisions.rationale: A separate durable plan prevents revised branch details from overwriting prior plan history.
